title: Inglourious Basterds
synopsis: A Jewish theater owner, a squad of avenging soldiers, and a Nazi premiere with a very flammable nitrate reel.

nodes.text: Landa drinks a glass of milk and asks polite questions in four languages.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Brave—follows you into whatever comes next.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Doomed—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Floorboards above and a girl in the dark holding her breath.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Run for the woods” back. Reckless shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Patient.

nodes.text: The premier audience does not survive the screening. History tilts. A face in smoke says her own name and means it.
Landa goes to Washington in a clean uniform with a fresh red swastika on his forehead that no surgeon will ever quite remove.
You sit in a dark theater with no Nazis in it and you eat strudel without cream and you weep without being seen.
